messages:
incidents-bot: Pager triggered: routing-fallback-high-latency (SEV2) for service 'inference-api' - elevated latency and unexpected model variant routing in us-west. Pager: @oncall-sre Maya.

maya: on it. joining the call (3m). any quick indicator of customer impact?

sam: seeing a spike in requests routed to `small-llama-q4` variant instead of `prod-llama-16b`. started ~2026-03-15T10:12Z after config push. p95 latency jumped from ~2.1s to ~4.8s for affected routes.

carol: confirmed. searching control-plane config history now. suspect the schema migration merged in the last deploy changed default behavior for the deprecated `region_fallback` field.

maya: timeline? which deploy?

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T10:10Z by @leo - PR #4821 - "configschema: migrate routing defaults" - commit abc1234

leo: that PR removed `region_fallback` from the schema and relied on implicit defaults from the new validator. we thought the validator preserved legacy defaults but apparently not.

sam: grabbing routing logs. snippet: ```
route_id: /v1/generate
user_tier: standard
routing_policy:
  model_variant: auto
  fallback: enabled
  # old config had: region_fallback: [us-west, us-east]
```

carol: aha — new validator treats missing `region_fallback` as 'global' which maps to a lower memory variant (small-llama-q4) in us-west. previously implicit default was to prefer `prod-llama-16b` for this customer tier.

maya: impact numbers? percent of traffic? customer-facing?

ops-bot: Metric snapshot (10:12-10:24Z): affected_routes => 22% of total inference requests; error rate rose 0.9% -> 3.4%; latency p95 for affected routes increased 2.1s -> 4.8s; no complete outages but several customer sessions reported increased latency and degraded outputs.

jordan: I'm taking pager. starting live mitigation: 1) apply runtime override to pin model_variant for critical routes, 2) rollback validator change or patch to preserve legacy default, 3) monitor.

maya: agreed. jordan do step 1 now. I will coordinate rollback with leo. sam, burn the routing logs to S3 and capture request ids for a follow-up eval.

jordan: applying runtime override: ```
POST /admin/overrides
{
  "selector": "/v1/generate",
  "override": {"routing_policy.default_model": "prod-llama-16b"},
  "ttl": "30m",
  "reason": "mitigate misrouting after schema change"
}
```

jordan: override applied. starting to see routing shift back to prod-llama-16b within 30s. p95 trending down.

maya: nice. next step: leo can you revert the validator migration in control-plane and push a hotfix that keeps legacy defaults? we should also add schema validation error if deprecated fields are used without an explicit mapping.

leo: on it. creating revert PR and a safety check to require explicit mapping when migrating away from `region_fallback`. PR #4830 opened. rolling to staging now, will promote to control-plane in ~10m if green.

sam: saved logs + sample request ids: s3://redwood-incident-logs/2743216789/requests-10-12-10-30.json.gz. pulled a few sample responses — deviation in output quality (more hallucinations) when routed to small-llama-q4.

kim: reaching out to account team for top 5 affected customers to preemptively notify. estimated affected sessions: 14k unique sessions during window.

maya: paging summary for oncall handoff: - incident: missed default mapping after configschema migration -> misrouting to low-capacity model variant - impact: elevated latency and quality regressions for ~22% traffic, no total outage - immediate mitigation: runtime override pinned critical routes to prod-llama-16b (applied) - control-plane hotfix in PR #4830 (in progress) - owner for postmortem: maya (will coordinate with leo + sam)

ops-bot: Alert update: routing-fallback-high-latency -> mitigated by override. watch window until 11:00Z.

jordan: handing off to maya for next shift at 10:50Z. I'm going offline for the emergency rotation.

maya: taking over. will continue monitoring and validate hotfix before fully closing. kim, get comms ready: short incident note + known impact + expected timeline for final fix.

kim: drafting now. suggestion: "We saw increased latency and unexpected model variant routing for a subset of inference requests due to a config schema migration. We applied a runtime override and are rolling a control-plane fix. No data loss or sustained outage. More details to follow."

leo: hotfix promoted to control-plane at 10:40Z. validator now preserves legacy default for `region_fallback` unless explicitly remapped. running integration smoke.

sam: smoke looks clean. p95 back to baseline on affected routes. error rate normalizing.

maya: good. final steps: 1) remove temporary override after verified (leave 10m grace), 2) add automated test in schema migration pipeline to catch default-changes, 3) customer follow-up and postmortem.

maya: removing override now.```

maya: override removed at 10:48Z. monitoring window.

ops-bot: Final metrics (10:30-10:48Z): affected traffic down to <1%, p95 restored to baseline, error rate reverted. Incident state: mitigated.

kim: comms sent to affected accounts at 10:55Z.

maya: incident closed for operational page. postmortem owner: maya. action items: - leo to ship migration-safety checks (PR #4830 merged) - sam to attach captured logs and customer examples to the postmortem - kim to finalize comms and customer-facing summary - jordan & oncall to update runbook for schema changes.

jordan: noted, will update runbook.

maya: thanks everyone. adding tag: follow-up / postmortem / schema-migration. :white_check_mark:
